responsibility: This file implements parsing of textual GIMPLE bodies accepted by the C front end for special function forms. It layers a gimple_parser state machine on top of c_parser tokens, parses GIMPLE expressions, statements, labels, switches, gotos, returns, declarations, and CFG annotations such as __BB edge specifications and profile probabilities, builds gimple sequences and control-flow edges, and validates simple return semantics against the current function declaration.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the concrete parser for textual GIMPLE bodies, implementing the gimple_parser state machine, statement/expression parsing, CFG edge handling, and return validation; gcc/c/gimple-parser.h is only the small public header exposing entry points used by the main C parser to invoke that functionality.
